description:
We're Astravelle — four ambitious minds driven by curiosity, creativity, and technology. With skills in web development, mobile apps, and project management, we're ready to turn NASA's data into impactful solutions.

We're looking for teammates interested in Python, AI/ML, data analysis, Earth science, visualization, and UI/UX design. We value fresh ideas, teamwork, and a willingness to learn.

Bring your curiosity. Let's build something extraordinary! 🚀
